findings.rule: frontend-ui-architecture: component folder anatomy (styles.ts always present); client/AGENTS.md
findings.summary: Eight sub-component folders have no own styles.ts and import the parent's `../../styles` instead
README shell lines are passed verbatim (no metachar/control-char filter) as run_locally commands and copied to the clipboard; only a UI warning mitigates it
Model prose fields (title/why/label/note/reason/summary) are not length-capped or sanitised
